systemArchitectures.name: Commercial Continuous Opposed Jet Micro-Capillary Hydrodynamic Skid (HC-HDJ)
systemArchitectures.classification: Industrial Ultra-High-Pressure Nano-Encapsulation & Liposome Skid (3-A Standards 04-05 & 44-03 / EHEDG Class I Aseptic)
systemArchitectures.interactionChamberTechnology: Single-Crystal Synthetic Diamond Y-Type Opposed Jet Interaction Chamber (Dual 75 µm Capillaries)
systemArchitectures.productContactMetallurgy: Electropolished AISI 316L (UNS S31603) & Solid Hastelloy C-22 (Ra ≤ 0.38 µm / 15 µ-in)
systemArchitectures.inLineQuenchSystem: Sanitary Dual-Tube Chilled Glycol Micro-Heat Exchanger (Quenches from 58°C to 18°C in <120 ms)
systemArchitectures.safetyInterlocks: Automatic Overpressure Rupture Disk (320 MPa), Ceramic Piston Leakage Sensors & CIP/SIP Interlock Relays
systemArchitectures.description: Flagship commercial continuous hydrodynamic jet skid engineered for sanitary ultra-narrow nano-liposome generation and high-yield encapsulation of sensitive bioactives, vitamins, and phytochemicals. Pressurizes phospholipid dispersions up to 280 MPa, impinging opposed micro-streams at 560 m/s inside a single-crystal diamond chamber to achieve sub-60 nm vesicles with zero metal particulate contamination and 0.00 cavitation pitting.

systemArchitectures.name: Industrial Multi-Channel Parallel Hydrodynamic Jet Skid
systemArchitectures.classification: Continuous High-Volume Nutraceutical & Functional Food Liposome Skid (FDA 21 CFR § 117 cGMP / CE-PED 2014/68/EU)
systemArchitectures.interactionChamberTechnology: Multi-Channel Parallel Opposed Diamond/Sapphire Array (6 Parallel 100 µm Capillary Channels)
systemArchitectures.productContactMetallurgy: Forged AISI 316L Stainless Steel with Hard Chrome-Plated Plungers and USP Class VI Perfluoroelastomer O-Rings
systemArchitectures.inLineQuenchSystem: Integrated Multi-Pass Counter-Current Chilled Glycol Tube Bundle (Exchanger Surface 4.2 m²)
systemArchitectures.safetyInterlocks: Dual Pressure Relief Valves, Continuous Vibration Accelerometers & Sanitary Flow Continuity Interlocks
systemArchitectures.description: Engineered for industrial beverage, functional dairy, and commercial nutraceutical facilities requiring high-throughput continuous encapsulation. Six parallel micro-capillary streams collide simultaneously, delivering up to 1,250 L/h of stable nano-liposomes with uniform colloidal particle size distributions.

systemArchitectures.name: Sanitary Concentric Hydrodynamic Jet Sheath-Flow Modeler Skid
systemArchitectures.classification: Continuous Laminar Micro-Focusing & Bioactive Nano-Precipitation System (3-A 74-07 / EHEDG Clean-In-Place Validated)
systemArchitectures.interactionChamberTechnology: Concentric Dual-Orifice Hydrodynamic Sheathing Nozzle (50 µm Core / 250 µm Annular Water Sheath)
systemArchitectures.productContactMetallurgy: Titanium Grade 5 Micro-Nozzle with Electropolished AISI 316L Sheath Housing
systemArchitectures.inLineQuenchSystem: Direct Solvent-Diffusion Aqueous Sheath Quenching with Sub-Jacket Glycol Chiller Plate
systemArchitectures.safetyInterlocks: Solvent Vapor Optical Sensors, Core-to-Sheath Pressure Differential Cutoffs & Inert N2 Purge Loop
systemArchitectures.description: Advanced laminar flow micro-focusing skid specialized for solvent-injection or ethanol-free aqueous liposome self-assembly. A high-pressure lipid core stream is hydrodynamically squeezed by outer aqueous sheath streams, inducing ultra-fast molecular diffusion and ultra-narrow vesicle self-assembly down to 40 nm.

systemArchitectures.name: Cleanroom Pilot Modular Hydrodynamic Jet Research & Validation Skid
systemArchitectures.classification: Modular GMP Pilot Encapsulation Skid (ISO 7 Class 10,000 Cleanroom / FDA 21 CFR § 117 & § 211)
systemArchitectures.interactionChamberTechnology: Interchangeable Modular Z-Type and Y-Type Diamond Micro-Reaction Chambers (50, 75, 100 µm)
systemArchitectures.productContactMetallurgy: Solid Vacuum-Melted Hastelloy C-22 & Diamond-Coated Micro-Channels (Ra ≤ 0.20 µm / 8 µ-in)
systemArchitectures.inLineQuenchSystem: Peltier-Assisted Sanitary Micro-Plate Chiller with Instantaneous Cryo-Glycol Boost
systemArchitectures.safetyInterlocks: Fiber-Optic Pressure Transducers, Micro-Leak Containment Shroud & 21 CFR Part 11 Audit Data Logger
systemArchitectures.description: Precision pilot and clinical validation skid designed for pharmaceutical-grade bioactive encapsulation, mRNA lipid nanoparticle (LNP) formulation testing, and pilot-scale functional food ingredient qualification with real-time pressure pulse analysis.

bioactiveSubstrates.name: Hydrophobic Curcumin & Phosphatidylcholine Phytosome Complex
bioactiveSubstrates.lipidComposition: 75 mol% Phosphatidylcholine (Soy/Sunflower) + 20 mol% Cholesterol + 5 mol% Phosphatidic Acid
bioactiveSubstrates.description: Poorly water-soluble curcuminoid molecules intercalate within the hydrophobic acyl core of the phospholipid bilayer during hydrodynamic jet collision, increasing oral bioavailability by over 28-fold compared to unencapsulated crystalline curcumin.

bioactiveSubstrates.name: Marine High-DHA/EPA Ethyl Ester & Phospholipid Nano-Liposome
bioactiveSubstrates.lipidComposition: 65 mol% Marine Phospholipids + 25 mol% Hydrogenated Sunflower PC + 10 mol% Alpha-Tocopherol (Antioxidant)
bioactiveSubstrates.description: Omega-3 fatty acids (EPA and DHA) are encapsulated within protective phospholipid membranes under nitrogen-blanketed hydrodynamic jet impingement, preventing fishy rancidity off-flavors, suppressing lipid peroxide values (PV < 0.5 meq/kg), and allowing fortification of clear beverages.

bioactiveSubstrates.name: Hydrophilic Vitamin C (L-Ascorbic Acid) & Reduced Glutathione (GSH)
bioactiveSubstrates.lipidComposition: 80 mol% Non-GMO Sunflower Phosphatidylcholine + 15 mol% Cholesterol + 5 mol% Stearylamine (Cationic Charge)
bioactiveSubstrates.description: Water-soluble Vitamin C and Glutathione are dissolved in the aqueous phase and entrained into the inner aqueous core of small unilamellar vesicles. Rapid jet shear forces achieve high volume entrapment without oxidation.

bioactiveSubstrates.name: Trans-Resveratrol & Pterostilbene Polyphenol Nano-Liposome
bioactiveSubstrates.lipidComposition: 70 mol% Egg-Yolk PC + 25 mol% Cholesterol + 5 mol% Phosphatidylglycerol
bioactiveSubstrates.description: Protects light-sensitive and oxidation-prone trans-resveratrol from isomerization into the biologically inactive cis-conformation, maintaining >98% active trans-isomer retention after 180 days.

bioactiveSubstrates.name: Coenzyme Q10 (Ubiquinone) Lipid Carrier Nanosphere
bioactiveSubstrates.lipidComposition: 60 mol% Medium-Chain Triglycerides (MCT) + 30 mol% Phosphatidylcholine + 10 mol% Polyglyceryl Esters
bioactiveSubstrates.description: CoQ10 crystals (melting point 48°C) are dissolved in molten MCT and sheared into uniform nano-carrier spheres, preventing re-crystallization and ensuring shelf-stable dispersion in liquid functional beverages.

bioactiveSubstrates.name: Plant-Based Dairy Volatile Terpenoid & Ester Nano-Carrier
bioactiveSubstrates.lipidComposition: 85 mol% Oat Phospholipids + 15 mol% Plant Sterols
bioactiveSubstrates.description: Encapsulates volatile buttery flavor notes (diacetyl, acetoin, delta-lactones) inside sub-50 nm transparent nano-liposomes, preventing headspace volatilization and extending freshness in oat, almond, and soy milks.

collisionChamberTechnologies.name: Y-Type Opposed Jet Single-Crystal Diamond Chamber
collisionChamberTechnologies.shearMechanism: Frontal Fluid-on-Fluid Planar Collision (Zero Metallic Impingement Wear)
collisionChamberTechnologies.advantages: Longest operational lifetime (>12,000 hours), zero metallic particle leaching, narrowest particle size distribution (PDI < 0.09).

collisionChamberTechnologies.name: Z-Type Micro-Channel Synthetic Sapphire Chamber
collisionChamberTechnologies.shearMechanism: High-Velocity Wall Boundary Layer Shear & Impact Turn Acceleration
collisionChamberTechnologies.advantages: Optimized for high-viscosity lipid pre-emulsions and coarse multi-lamellar vesicle reduction.

collisionChamberTechnologies.name: Concentric Dual-Jet Hydrodynamic Sheath Nozzle
collisionChamberTechnologies.shearMechanism: Axisymmetric Hydrodynamic Focusing with Fast Solvent Miscibility Gradient
collisionChamberTechnologies.advantages: Enables ultra-small liposome sizing down to 35–45 nm with minimal shear denaturation of delicate protein ligands.

regulatoryStandards.title: Sanitary Standards for Homogenizers and Reciprocating High Pressure Pumps
regulatoryStandards.scope: Mandates cleanability, crevice-free piston cylinder blocks, food-grade sanitary packings, and drainability.

regulatoryStandards.title: Sanitary Standards for In-Line Diaphragm Resonators and High Pressure Flow Equipment
regulatoryStandards.scope: Establishes mechanical design tolerances, surface finish (Ra ≤ 0.38 µm), and CIP validation for high-pressure interaction cavities.

regulatoryStandards.title: Sanitary Standards for Sensors and Sensor Fittings Used on Milk and Food Equipment
regulatoryStandards.scope: Requires flush-mounted aseptic diaphragm pressure transducers and temperature sensors with zero dead-legs.

regulatoryStandards.title: Hygienic Equipment Design Principles for Closed Food Processing Equipment
regulatoryStandards.scope: Specifies continuous clean-in-place flow rates, self-draining geometries, and elimination of microbial entrapment voids.

regulatoryStandards.title: Current Good Manufacturing Practice (cGMP) in Manufacturing, Processing, Packing Food
regulatoryStandards.scope: Requires hazard analysis, validated preventive controls, and absence of metallic or toxic adulterants in food streams.
